critical_code_review_comments: Mixed testability conventions inside contact/* components: some use data-testid prop (unreliable on RN core primitives via RNW), others use testID + dataSet + tid(). Recommend standardising on testID+dataSet (or tid()) for all React Native primitives so query_selector('[data-testid=…]') is deterministic. Impacts: composer-input, refresh-calls-btn (already fixed), and any TextInput/TouchableOpacity that only sets data-testid.

Console produces 404 'Contact not found' warnings when navigating between contacts in the same session — a stale fetch continues after route changes. Consider AbortController on the useEffect cleanup in /app/frontend/app/contact/[id].tsx to avoid noisy errors and potential race conditions on very slow networks.

profile-dates-section: when a contact has no birthday, the 'Add birthday' row replaces the birthday-optin toggle. Consider also exposing the optin row (disabled) so users understand the automation exists but requires a date — small UX and testability improvement.
action_items: Align composer-input (and any other RN primitives using raw data-testid) to testID + dataSet + tid() so tests can target them reliably.
Optionally clean up stale contact fetches on route change to eliminate 404 console errors.

Optional UX: still show birthday auto-text opt-in when birthday is missing (disabled) instead of hiding the row entirely — otherwise QA scripts expecting birthday-optin-row on every contact fail as they did here.

Forest Ward tags <=3 so +N tag chip not exercised; if you need to test hero-more-tags-btn, add ≥4 tags to a QA contact and clean up. Do NOT toggle auto-text switches or send messages on Forest.
rca of the issue: refresh-calls-btn: React Native Web only forwards `data-testid` reliably when it appears in the component's dataSet or via testID convention; setting it directly on TouchableOpacity's props is silently dropped by some RN versions used here. Fix was to switch to testID + dataSet like the rest of the file.
